items.cn: vallum 意为壁垒或栅栏，是罗马营地的土与桩。

items.en: The word is related to vallus, a stake, and camp walls were once made of such stakes.
items.cn: 这个词与 vallus（桩）有关，营地之墙原本就是用这样的木桩做的。

items.en: Roman engineers built and maintained walls in Britain, and weall passed into English.
items.cn: 罗马工兵在不列颠修筑与维护城墙，weall 随之进入英语。

items.en: The English word moved from military ramparts to the walls of houses and gardens.
items.cn: 英语的这个字从军事壁垒移用到房屋与院落的墙上。

items.en: Modern speech adds figurative walls and the compounds firewall and wallpaper.
items.cn: 现代英语又添出比喻的「墙」，以及 firewall、wallpaper 这类复合词。

note.en: The first group gathers the wall family and its compounds, the second the words for barriers nearby.
note.cn: 第一组收 wall 词族与复合词，第二组收附近表示阻隔的词。

entries.definition: The plural and the third person singular.
Enclosed by a wall, as in a walled city.
A barrier that stops fire, or a computer defence.
Paper pasted on a room wall.
A barrier of posts and wire, lighter than a wall.
Anything that blocks the way.
An earth bank raised for defence, the old form of wall.
An opening in a wall made for passing through.

normalIntro.en: Wall began as a camp rampart, so it keeps the sense of a hard edge that keeps things out.
normalIntro.cn: wall 起初是营寨的壁垒，所以一直保留「把人挡在外面」的硬边之意。

normal.en: A wall holds up a roof outside and is painted inside.
normal.cn: 墙在外撑屋顶，在内可刷色。

normal.en: Wall up means to block an opening with bricks.
normal.cn: wall up 指用砖把开口堵上。

normal.en: Drive someone up the wall means to annoy them badly.
normal.cn: drive someone up the wall 指把人气得抓狂。

normal.en: A firewall is a wall against fire, and against computer attack.
normal.cn: firewall 是挡火之墙，也是挡攻击之墙。

normal.en: Old spelling shares the Latin root with valley, oddly enough.
normal.cn: 有趣的是，它与 valley 共享同一拉丁词根。

abstract.en: See bricks laid in rows up to the eye line.
abstract.cn: 想砖一层层砌到齐眉高。

abstract.en: Feel afternoon sun stored in warm stone.
abstract.cn: 感受下午的阳光存进暖石里。

abstract.en: Picture a silence that stops every question at the door.
abstract.cn: 想一种沉默，把每个问题挡在门口。

examples.en: The walls of the old house are very thick.
examples.cn: 这座老房子的墙非常厚。

examples.en: A hedge and a wall separate the two gardens.
examples.cn: 一道树篱和一堵墙把两个花园隔开。

examples.en: There is a crack in the wall behind the picture.
examples.cn: 画后面的墙上有一道裂缝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「窝儿」——把窝儿四周围起来，暖和又安全，那就是一堵墙。

root: 拉丁语 vallum（壁垒）→ 古英语 weall（城墙）→ 现代英语 wall。

sensesIntro.en: A Roman rampart becomes the shell of a house, the fence of a garden, and then any barrier at all, ending in the verb.
sensesIntro.cn: 罗马的壁垒变成房子的外壳、院子的篱墙，再变成任何阻隔，最后变作动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: bricks laid up to the eye line.
core.cn: 核心意象：一层层砌到齐眉高的砖。

branches.en: The stone branch: a low wall along a garden.
branches.cn: 石头分支：花园边的矮墙。

branches.en: The room branch: a painting above a desk.
branches.cn: 房间分支：书桌上方的画。

branches.en: The barrier branch: silence, and a wave like a wall.
branches.cn: 阻隔分支：沉默与如墙之浪。

branches.en: The building branch: a walled and gated town.
branches.cn: 修砌分支：有墙有门的老城。

branches.en: The metaphor branch: answers that hit the wall.
branches.cn: 比喻分支：撞在墙上的回应。

intro.en: Wall is a whole borrowed word; its family is English compounds such as firewall and the ending -ed.
intro.cn: wall 是整词借入，词族由 firewall 这类英语复合词与 -ed 词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin vallum and vallus are recorded, and the borrowed form went through Old English weall.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vallum 与 vallus 有文献记录，借入的词形经由古英语 weall。

items.example: The source of the borrowed word.
Roman camps were ringed with it.

definition_zh: 钱包；皮夹；钱夹
definition_en: a small flat case, often of leather, for carrying money, cards and papers
core_image: 一个对折的皮夹，翻开是几张卡和折起的钞票
scene: 结账时他从后袋里掏出那个被磨得发白的皮夹，抽出卡递过去。He found his wallet was gone when he reached the ticket desk.
sceneCN: 这里 wallet 是「钱包」（第 1 个义项：装钱、卡与票证的小扁平夹子）；句意为他走到售票台时发现钱包不见了。磨白的对折皮夹那幅画就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: A case for money and cards
senses.definition: a small flat folding case for carrying notes, cards and a few papers
senses.definitionCN: 装纸币、卡与少量证件的小型对折扁平夹子
senses.example: He found his wallet was gone when he reached the ticket desk.
senses.exampleCN: 他走到售票台时发现钱包不见了。
senses.why: The word came from a bag for the back and for travel, and the money case is only its latest job.
senses.whyCN: 这个词原指背在背上或旅行用的袋子，装钱只是它最近的一份工作。

senses.title: Older words for a bag
senses.definition: in old British use, a bag or knapsack carried when travelling
senses.definitionCN: 旧英式用法中指旅行时携带的袋子或背包
senses.example: The boy set off with a wallet of clothes over his shoulder.
senses.exampleCN: 那男孩肩上挎着一包衣服就出发了。
senses.why: The bag sense came first, and a few dialects keep it for a bundle of clothes or food.
senses.whyCN: 袋子这一层来得最早，少数方言里仍用它指一包衣服或食物。

senses.title: A small case of papers
senses.definition: in old use, a case for papers or tools rather than for money
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用法中指而不是装钱的文件或工具夹
senses.example: The surveyor kept his maps in a canvas wallet.
senses.exampleCN: 测量员把地图放在一只帆布夹里。
senses.why: Before it meant money, the word named any flat case that carried papers, and this use survives in a few trades.
senses.whyCN: 在指钱之前，这个词泛指装纸件的扁平夹，这一用法在少数行业里仍存。

senses.title: A digital holding place
senses.definition: now also a phone service or app that stores money and cards
senses.definitionCN: 如今也指在手机里存放钱与卡的软件服务
senses.example: Many people now pay from a wallet on their phone.
senses.exampleCN: 如今很多人用手机里的电子钱包付款。
senses.why: A wallet is a holding place, so the app that holds money simply takes the old name.
senses.whyCN: 钱包就是个盛放之处，于是装钱的软件直接沿用了这个旧名。

intro.en: Wallet is from Old French walet, a bag or a roll carried for travel, of uncertain older origin.
intro.cn: wallet 来自古法语 walet，指旅行用的袋子或铺盖卷，更早的来源不甚确定。

items.en: Walet meant a bag, a knapsack, or a roll of bedding carried on the back.
items.cn: walet 意为袋子、背包，或背在背上的铺盖卷。

items.en: The word probably goes back to a Germanic root for rolling or turning over, which fits a bedroll.
items.cn: 这个词大概追溯到日耳曼语表示滚动、翻卷的词根，正好合于铺盖卷。

items.en: English took it for a bag of food and clothes for a journey, and later for a small case.
items.cn: 英语先用它指旅途中的食物与衣物袋，后来才指小夹子。

items.en: By the nineteenth century the leather case for notes and cards had taken over the meaning.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，装纸币与卡片的皮夹终于占了这一词义。

items.en: The digital wallet of the twenty-first century repeats the pattern: an old word for a holding place.
items.cn: 二十一世纪的电子钱包重复了同一模式：一个古老表示「盛放之处」的词。

note.en: The first group gathers the money-case family, the second the other receptacles for money and papers.
note.cn: 第一组收装钱的夹子类词，第二组收其他装钱与票据的器物。

entries.definition: The plural form, with -s.
A wallet kept in a phone.
A small bag for money, now often a woman’s.
The American word for a folding wallet.
Any container with a lid or a fold.
A small holder for cards only.
A soft container with an opening, larger than a wallet.
Where money is held without any case at all.

normalIntro.en: Wallet began as a travelling bag, so the memory can start from a bag over the shoulder and shrink to a pocket.
normalIntro.cn: wallet 起初是旅行袋，可以从肩上那只袋子想起，再缩到口袋里。

normal.en: A wallet was once a bag; now it fits in a pocket.
normal.cn: wallet 曾是袋子，如今装进衣袋。

normal.en: British purse and American billfold overlap with it.
normal.cn: 英式 purse 与美式 billfold 都与它重叠。

normal.en: An e-wallet is a wallet without leather.
normal.cn: e-wallet 是没有皮革的钱包。

normal.en: You open a wallet and lose a wallet; both are common.
normal.cn: open a wallet 与 lose a wallet 都很常用。

normal.en: Do not confuse it with walet, the French bag it came from.
normal.cn: 别与它的法语来源 walet（袋子）混淆。

abstract.en: See a worn fold showing at the back pocket.
abstract.cn: 想后袋露出的那道磨白的折边。

abstract.en: Hear cards click as the case opens.
abstract.cn: 听夹子打开时卡片一响。

abstract.en: Picture a phone paying for a bus fare.
abstract.cn: 想一部手机刷开车费。

examples.en: He pulled a few notes from his wallet.
examples.cn: 他从钱包里抽出几张钞票。

examples.en: She keeps her tickets in the front of her wallet.
examples.cn: 她把车票放在钱包的前层。

examples.en: Losing your wallet abroad is always difficult.
examples.cn: 在国外丢钱包总是很麻烦。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「窝了它」——钱有个窝，一折起来就把它们窝了它在里头。

root: 古法语 walet（旅行袋；铺盖卷），更早或出自日耳曼语表示滚动、翻卷的词根，来源不甚确定。

sensesIntro.en: A travelling bag shrinks into a pocket case, and the same name now covers the phone that holds your money.
sensesIntro.cn: 一只旅行袋缩成口袋里的夹子，同一个名字如今又罩住了装钱的手机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a worn leather fold.
core.cn: 核心意象：磨白的皮折。

branches.en: The pocket branch: missing at the ticket desk.
branches.cn: 口袋分支：售票台前不见了。

branches.en: The travel branch: a bag of clothes on one shoulder.
branches.cn: 旅行分支：肩上挎一包衣服。

branches.en: The papers branch: maps in a canvas case.
branches.cn: 证件分支：帆布夹里的地图。

branches.en: The digital branch: paying by phone.
branches.cn: 数字分支：用手机付款。

branches.en: The money branch: notes in leather or in an app.
branches.cn: 钱财分支：钞票在皮革里或在应用里。

intro.en: Wallet is a whole borrowed word; the modern family is made of compounds such as e-wallet.
intro.cn: wallet 是整词借入，现代词族由 e-wallet 这类复合词构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; the word came from Old French and possibly a Germanic root, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语来源，出自古法语，可能上溯日耳曼词根，因此拉丁条目为空。

items.example: The direct source of the word.
It forms billfold, the American counterpart.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 billfold，美式对应词。

definition_zh: 想要；希望；需要；缺少
definition_en: to wish to have something or to wish to do something
core_image: 一只手伸出去，指尖还差一点才碰到东西
scene: 孩子站在橱窗外，手贴在玻璃上，什么也没说，只是看着里面那双鞋。The little boy wanted the red bicycle more than anything.
sceneCN: 这里 want 是「想要」（第 1 个义项：希望拥有某物或做某事）；句意为小男孩最想要那辆红色自行车。手伸出去还差一点的那幅画就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: To wish for something
senses.definition: to desire to have something or to have something happen
senses.definitionCN: 希望拥有某物，或希望某事发生
senses.example: The little boy wanted the red bicycle more than anything.
senses.exampleCN: 小男孩最想要那辆红色自行车。
senses.why: The oldest English sense is to lack, and desire grows out of lack: what you have not, you want.
senses.whyCN: 英语最早的一层是「缺少」，而渴望正从缺少里长出：没有的东西就是你所想要的。

senses.title: Lacking something
senses.definition: to lack a thing or a quality, or to be short by a measure
senses.definitionCN: 缺少某物或某种性质，或差出一定数量
senses.example: The room wants only a lamp to be complete.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间只差一盏灯就齐全了。
senses.why: This is the original sense, still common in formal English.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的一层，在正式英语里仍常见。

senses.title: To need something done
senses.definition: to need a thing or a person to be dealt with, used with a past participle
senses.definitionCN: 需要某事或某人被处理，后接过去分词
senses.example: These windows want cleaning.
senses.exampleCN: 这些窗户该擦了。
senses.why: Need and lack are close: if something lacks care, it needs care.
senses.whyCN: 需要与缺少本是一家：缺了照料，就是需要被照料。

senses.title: To be sought by authority
senses.definition: in the passive, of a person, to be looked for by the police
senses.definitionCN: 被动式中指被警方寻找
senses.example: The man was wanted in three counties.
senses.exampleCN: 那个人在三个郡被通缉。
senses.why: A person the court wants is somebody the law desires to lay hands on, so the old sense takes a new object.
senses.whyCN: 法庭想要的人，就是法律渴望捉到的人，于是旧义换了个新宾语。

senses.title: To lack in a formal phrase
senses.definition: in set phrases, the state of lacking something, as in for want of
senses.definitionCN: 在固定短语中表示缺少某物，如 for want of
senses.example: The plan failed for want of money.
senses.exampleCN: 这个计划因缺少资金而失败。
senses.why: The fixed phrase keeps the earliest sense alive in a formal register.
senses.whyCN: 这个固定短语在正式语体里让最早的一层继续活着。

senses.title: Poverty or need
senses.definition: in older use, the state of living without what you need
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用法指缺少生活所需的状态
senses.example: The family fell into want after the mill closed.
senses.exampleCN: 磨坊关了以后，这家人陷入贫困。
senses.why: If want is a lack, then being in want is living with that lack every day.
senses.whyCN: 若 want 就是缺少，那么 in want 就是天天活在这种缺少里。

intro.en: Want is from Old Norse vanta, to be lacking, which entered English from the north.
intro.cn: want 来自古诺尔斯语 vanta（缺少），从北方进入英语。

items.en: Vanta meant to lack or to be short of a thing, and it came in with Norse settlement.
items.cn: vanta 意为缺少或差一点，随北欧人的定居进入英语。

items.en: The root is Germanic and meant to be missing, without any of the later desire.
items.cn: 这个词根是日耳曼语，意为「缺」，尚不含后来的渴望之义。

items.en: In Middle English to want still meant to lack, as it does today in for want of.
items.cn: 到了中古英语，to want 仍指缺少，今天的 for want of 还保留这一层。

items.en: From lacking things it moved to wishing for them: a want is a need felt.
items.cn: 从缺少东西走向希望得到东西：一个 want 就是一种被感到的需要。

items.en: The modern sense to wish became the most common, while the older senses stayed in formal speech.
items.cn: 现代「想要」成了最常用的一层，较早的义项则留在正式语里。

note.en: The first group gathers the want family, the second the verbs of wishing that sit closest to it.
note.cn: 第一组收 want 词族，第二组收与它最近的表示意愿的动词。

entries.definition: Third person singular, and also the plural noun.
entries.definitionCN: 第三人称单数与复数名词

entries.definition: Seen on posters for missing persons.
Lacking something, or below standard.
Not desired, often of goods or advice.
To be necessary, a stronger and more serious word.
To want something that may not be possible.
To be without, the older sense kept alone.
To refuse what is offered.

normalIntro.en: Want is a word of lack, so every want begins with a space not yet filled.
normalIntro.cn: want 是个表示缺少的词，每个 want 都始于一处尚未填满的空。

normal.en: Want first meant to lack, which is why for want of still means lacking.
normal.cn: want 起初意为缺少，所以 for want of 仍指因缺。

normal.en: Want to is followed by the plain verb: want to go.
normal.cn: want to 后接动词原形：want to go。

normal.en: Windows want cleaning shows it can mean need.
normal.cn: windows want cleaning 显示它可表示「需要」。

normal.en: Wanted on a poster means the police are looking for you.
normal.cn: 海报上的 wanted 指警方在找你。

normal.en: When in want was once the same as being poor.
normal.cn: in want 曾经就是指贫困。

abstract.en: See a hand almost touching a shoe in a window.
abstract.cn: 想一只手几乎碰到橱窗里的鞋。

abstract.en: Feel the small gap between fingertips and glass.
abstract.cn: 感受指尖与玻璃之间那一点空隙。

abstract.en: Picture a room almost complete but for one lamp.
abstract.cn: 想一间几乎齐备、只差一盏灯的房间。

examples.en: Do you want anything from the shop?
examples.cn: 你从店里要带什么吗？

examples.en: The car wants a new battery.
examples.cn: 这辆车需要换新电池。

examples.en: He failed for want of experience.
examples.cn: 他因缺乏经验而失败。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「往里」——手往里伸，指头够不着，所以心里就想要。

root: 古诺尔斯语 vanta（缺少）→ 中古英语 want（缺少）→ 现代英语 want（想要）；日耳曼语词根，意为「缺」。

sensesIntro.en: The word begins at lack and reaches out into desire, need, official searching, formal lack and old poverty.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从「缺少」出发，再伸向渴望、需要、官方寻人、正式的欠缺和旧的贫困。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand just short of the thing.
core.cn: 核心意象：手差点就要碰到。

branches.en: The desire branch: a red bicycle above all else.
branches.cn: 欲望分支：最想要那辆红自行车。

branches.en: The lack branch: a room short of a lamp, a plan short of money.
branches.cn: 欠缺分支：只差一盏灯的房间，缺钱的计划。

branches.en: The need branch: windows that want cleaning.
branches.cn: 需要分支：该擦的窗户。

branches.en: The pursuit branch: a man wanted in three counties.
branches.cn: 追索分支：在三个郡被通缉的人。

branches.en: The old poverty branch: a family fallen into want.
branches.cn: 旧贫困分支：陷入匮乏的一家人。

intro.en: Want is a whole borrowed verb; its family comes from English endings such as -ed, -ing and un-.
intro.cn: want 是整词借入的动词，词族由 -ed、-ing、un- 等英语词缀构成。

latinIntro.en: The word came from Old Norse, with no Latin source, so the Latin list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词出自古诺尔斯语，没有拉丁语来源，因此拉丁条目为空。

items.example: The recorded source of the word.
It forms wantless, a rare word.

definition_zh: 战争；战事；斗争
definition_en: fighting between countries or groups with weapons over a long period
core_image: 地图上的两条战线，中间夹着一段没有人敢耕的地
scene: 旧相册里有一张黑白照片，几个年轻人站在泥里，背景是烧了一半的村子。The country was at war for more than ten years.
sceneCN: 这里 war 是「战争」（第 1 个义项：国家或群体之间长期持械交战）；句意为这个国家打了十多年仗。地图上两条战线的那幅画就是这个词的印象。

senses.title: Fighting between nations
senses.definition: organized armed fighting between countries or large groups, lasting over time
senses.definitionCN: 国家或大团体之间长期组织的持械交战
senses.example: The country was at war for more than ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家打了十多年仗。
senses.why: The word grew next to a Germanic form of the same base that also gave worse, and the meaning settled on armed conflict.
senses.whyCN: 这个词与同基底表示「更糟」的日耳曼语形式并行生长，词义最后落定在持械冲突上。

senses.title: A campaign against something
senses.definition: a determined effort to defeat a problem, such as disease or poverty
senses.definitionCN: 为克服疾病、贫困等问题而作的坚决努力
senses.example: The city began a war on rats in the old sewers.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市开始了一场治理旧下水道鼠患的战争。
senses.why: Modern English extends the word to any long struggle that needs organized effort.
senses.whyCN: 现代英语把这个词扩展到任何需要组织起来的长期斗争。

senses.title: A struggle between ideas
senses.definition: in phrases such as a war of words, a fierce exchange of hostile speech
senses.definitionCN: 在 a war of words 等短语中指激烈的相互指责
senses.example: The debate turned into a war of words between the two professors.
senses.exampleCN: 辩论变成了两位教授之间的一场论战。
senses.why: Words that are exchanged like blows are described as a war, though nothing is broken.
senses.whyCN: 像拳脚一样来回抛的言语被叫作战争，尽管什么也没被打破。

senses.title: The state of being at war
senses.definition: the condition of opposing forces, as in war and peace
senses.definitionCN: 敌对力量相持的状态，如 war and peace 并用
senses.example: The novel opens in the year before the war.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说从战争前一年写起。
senses.why: English names the condition as well as the events, so one can live in the year before it.
senses.whyCN: 英语既命名事件也命名状态，所以人可以在它开始前的那一年里生活。

intro.en: War comes from Old Northern French werre, which spread from a Germanic word for confusion or disorder.
intro.cn: war 来自古北法语 werre，而后者源自日耳曼语表示混乱、纷扰的词。

items.en: A Germanic word for confusion or strife lies behind the French form, related to a form that gave worse.
items.cn: 法语词形背后是一个表示混乱、纷争的日耳曼语词，与给出 worse 的词形相关。

items.en: Old Northern French werre meant war, and Norman French brought it to England.
items.cn: 古北法语 werre 意为战争，诺曼法语把它带到英格兰。

items.en: English had its own word, werre, and the two forms settled into war.
items.cn: 英语本有 werre 一词，两种形式最后定形为 war。

items.en: The word was used of sieges and campaigns, and only later of wars between states.
items.cn: 这个词曾用于围城与战役，后来才专指国家之间的战争。

items.en: Modern English adds the war on disease and the war of words, both borrowed from bodily fighting.
items.cn: 现代英语又添出抗击疾病的战争与论战，都借自真实的打斗。

note.en: The first group gathers the fighting family, the second the words for conflicts of different scale.
note.cn: 第一组收战争词族，第二组收不同规模的冲突词。

entries.definition: The plural form, short and easily confused with wears.
entries.definitionCN: 复数，易与 wears 相混

entries.definition: The activity of fighting, of any kind.
A fighter, often in older writing.
In conflict with each other.
One armed fight, smaller than a war.
A broad word for any clash.
A planned series of actions in a war.
The state of not fighting.

normalIntro.en: War is a short old word with a long shadow; keep it apart from its look-alike wear.
normalIntro.cn: war 是个短小的古词，影子却长；记它时要与形近的 wear 分开。

normal.en: War is short and hard, like the thing itself.
normal.cn: war 又短又硬，正如它所表示的。

normal.en: Wear, with an e, means to have on or to erode.
normal.cn: wear 带 e，指穿或磨损。

normal.en: Be at war is the state; declare war is the act.
normal.cn: be at war 是状态，declare war 是行为。

normal.en: Warfare is the activity; warrior is the person.
normal.cn: warfare 是活动，warrior 是人。

normal.en: A war of words is loud and bloodless.
normal.cn: a war of words 是吵闹却不见血的。

abstract.en: See two lines on a map with empty ground between.
abstract.cn: 想地图上两条线，中间是一片空着的地。

abstract.en: Smell burnt timber in a half-ruined village.
abstract.cn: 闻半毁村落里焦木的气味。

abstract.en: Hear two professors raising their voices, not their hands.
abstract.cn: 听两位教授提高的是嗓门而不是手。

examples.en: The war lasted four years and changed the country.
examples.cn: 这场战争持续四年，改变了这个国家。

examples.en: Doctors are waging a war on smoking.
examples.cn: 医生们正在开展一场控烟的战争。

examples.en: After the war the town was slowly rebuilt.
examples.cn: 战后这座小镇被慢慢重建起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哇」——警报一响，人人「哇」的一声跑开，那就是它。

root: 日耳曼语「混乱、纷争」→ 古北法语 werre（战争）→ 中古英语 war。

sensesIntro.en: Armed fighting gives the core, and the word then lends itself to campaigns against disease, to verbal battles and to the plain state of conflict.
sensesIntro.cn: 持械交战是核心，这个词随后又借给抗病之战、言语论战以及抽象的冲突状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two lines with empty ground between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条战线夹着空出的地。

branches.en: The nations branch: ten years of fighting.
branches.cn: 国家分支：十年的交兵。

branches.en: The campaign branch: doctors against smoking.
branches.cn: 活动分支：医生对付吸烟。

branches.en: The words branch: two professors out loud.
branches.cn: 言语分支：两位教授的对吵。

branches.en: The state branch: the year before it began.
branches.cn: 状态分支：开始前的那一年。

branches.en: The peace branch: war and peace set against each other.
branches.cn: 和平分支：战争与和平相对并列。

intro.en: War is a whole word; its family comes from English compounds and endings such as -fare, -ior and -like.
intro.cn: war 是整词，词族由 -fare、-ior、-like 等英语后缀与复合构成。

latinIntro.en: The word came through French from a Germanic root, with no Latin source, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词由日耳曼词根经法语传入，没有拉丁语来源，因此拉丁条目为空。

items.example: The form that came to England.
It forms warhead, the front of a missile.

definition_zh: 观看；注视；看护；手表；看守；值班
definition_en: to look at something attentively over a period of time, and a small clock worn on the wrist
core_image: 一个人停在路边，眼睛跟着走过的东西慢慢转动
scene: 球场边有人站着不动，眼睛始终追着那只球。He kept watch at the gate until dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 watch 是「观看、注视」（第 1 个义项：持续一段时间专注地看）；句意为他在门口守夜到天亮。眼睛跟着球慢慢转动的那幅画就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 加 -er 构成，义为「观察者；看守人」
加 -ful 构成，义为「警惕的；留心的」
复合词，义为「守夜人；更夫」

senses.title: To look at for a while
senses.definition: to look at someone or something attentively for a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内专注地看某人或某物
senses.example: They watched the boats come in from the harbour wall.
senses.exampleCN: 他们站在港口的堤上看船进港。
senses.why: The oldest sense is steady looking, which is the base for all the others.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是持续地看，这是其余义项的基础。

senses.title: To guard or look after
senses.definition: to stay with someone or something in order to protect or care for it
senses.definitionCN: 守着某人或某物以保护或照看
senses.example: A nurse watched the child through the night.
senses.exampleCN: 一位护士整夜照看那个孩子。
senses.why: A watcher who stays awake to protect is doing the same thing as watching, only with a duty attached.
senses.whyCN: 醒着守候以保护别人的人，做的仍是「看」，只是多了一份职责。

senses.title: To be careful of
senses.definition: to be careful about something, especially in the phrase watch out
senses.definitionCN: 对某事小心，尤用于 watch out 这一说法
senses.example: Watch out for the step at the door.
senses.exampleCN: 当心门口的台阶。
senses.why: To be careful is to keep your eyes on a danger, so the verb of looking came to mean warning.
senses.whyCN: 小心就是盯着危险看，于是表示「看」的动词也有了提醒之意。

senses.title: The clock on the wrist
senses.definition: a small clock worn on the wrist or carried in a pocket
senses.definitionCN: 戴在腕上或装在口袋里的小钟表
senses.example: His watch stopped at ten past four.
senses.exampleCN: 他的手表停在四点十分。
senses.why: Early watches were carried by men who had to stay awake on duty, and the little clock took the name of that duty.
senses.whyCN: 早期的表由必须保持清醒值守的人携带，这只小钟便沿用了「值守」这个名字。

senses.title: A period of duty
senses.definition: a period of time during which a person is on duty, especially on a ship
senses.definitionCN: 某人值班的一段时间，尤指在船上
senses.example: The captain took the first watch of the night.
senses.exampleCN: 船长值了夜里的第一班岗。
senses.why: Sailors divided the night into named watches, and the word still means the stretch of duty itself.
senses.whyCN: 水手把夜晚分成若干有名目的班次，这个词至今仍指那一段值守时间。

intro.en: Watch began as a verb meaning to stay awake, and only later came to mean to look and then the little clock itself.
intro.cn: watch 起初是「保持清醒」的动词，后来才指「看」，最后又指那只小钟。

items.en: The verb wæccan meant to be awake or to keep awake, often at night.
items.cn: 动词 wæccan 意为「醒着」或「使人不睡」，常在夜里使用。

items.en: A related noun wæcc gave watch in the sense of a period of staying awake.
items.cn: 同源名词 wæcc 衍生出「守夜时段」这一义的 watch。

items.en: By the fourteenth century watch meant both to be on guard and to look at, and the looking sense grew strong.
items.cn: 到十四世纪，watch 兼指「警戒」与「看」，而「看」这一义日益增强。

items.en: In the sixteenth century a small portable clock was called a watch, since it kept you awake on time.
items.cn: 十六世纪，小的便携钟表被称为 watch，因为它能按时把人叫醒。

items.en: The modern verb is used for television, games and any long, steady looking.
items.cn: 现代用法中，这个动词覆盖电视、比赛以及任何长时间持续的看。

note.en: The first group gathers forms and look-alikes of watch, the second the verbs of looking and the other timepiece words.
note.cn: 第一组收 watch 的形式与形近词，第二组收「看」一类动词以及钟表词。

entries.definition: Third person singular and the plural of the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 第三人称单数，也是名词复数

entries.definition: Past tense and past participle.
One who watches.
The adjective meaning alert.
To turn the eyes to something, often briefly.
To watch carefully in order to learn.
A timepiece, usually large or on a wall.
entries.definitionCN: 钟，通常较大或挂在墙上

entries.definition: To protect by staying near.

normalIntro.en: Awake, then look, then a small clock: the history runs from staying alert to telling the time.
normalIntro.cn: 先醒着，再看，最后是只小钟：历史从「保持警觉」走到「报时」。

normal.en: Watch out is a warning: keep your eyes on the danger.
normal.cn: watch out 是提醒：眼睛盯着危险。

normal.en: You watch TV but you look at a picture.
normal.cn: watch TV 只看电视，看一幅画用 look at。

normal.en: Keep watch is to stay awake and guard.
normal.cn: keep watch 是守夜警戒。

normal.en: A watch on the wrist, a clock on the wall.
normal.cn: 腕上是 watch，墙上是 clock。

normal.en: Add -ful for the adjective: watchful, alert.
normal.cn: 加 -ful 得形容词：watchful（警觉的）。

abstract.en: See a still figure whose eyes follow a passing boat.
abstract.cn: 想一个不动的人，眼睛跟着经过的船。

abstract.en: Feel a night spent awake by a door.
abstract.cn: 感受在门边醒着度过的一夜。

abstract.en: Picture a small dial ticking on a wrist.
abstract.cn: 想腕上一只小表盘在走。

examples.en: We watched the sun go down behind the hills.
examples.cn: 我们看着太阳落到山后。

examples.en: Could you watch my bag for a minute?
examples.cn: 你能帮我看一下包吗？

examples.en: Watch out for ice on the path.
examples.cn: 当心小路上的冰。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瓦奇」——瓦奇守在门口一动不动，眼睛一直盯着走廊尽头，连表都忘了看。

root: 古英语 wæccan（保持清醒、守夜）与同源名词 wæcc（守夜时段）合为 watch。

sensesIntro.en: Steady looking comes first, then guarding, then the warning, and finally the wrist clock and the night watch on a ship.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是持续地看，接着是守护，然后是提醒，最后落在腕上的表与船上的夜班岗。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an eye following a moving thing.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只跟着移动之物转动的眼睛。

branches.en: The looking branch: boats coming into harbour.
branches.cn: 观看分支：进港的船。

branches.en: The guarding branch: a nurse through the night.
branches.cn: 守护分支：守夜的护士。

branches.en: The warning branch: a step at the door.
branches.cn: 提醒分支：门口的台阶。

branches.en: The timepiece branch: a dial that stopped.
branches.cn: 钟表分支：停住的小表盘。

branches.en: The duty branch: the captain’s first watch.
branches.cn: 值班分支：船长的第一班岗。

intro.en: Watch takes -er for the person, -ful for the adjective and -es in the third person, and combines in watchman and stopwatch.
intro.cn: watch 加 -er 成指人的词，加 -ful 成形容词，第三人称加 -es，还与 man、stop 组成复合词。

latinIntro.en: Watch is native English from Old English wæccan, with no Latin source, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: watch 是源自古英语 wæccan 的本族词，没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁条目为空。

definition_zh: 水；水域；浇水；给…喝水
definition_en: the clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers and seas, and to pour it on plants or give it to animals
core_image: 一捧从井里舀起的水，指缝间淌下细细的水线
scene: 她每天清早提着桶去井边，回来时鞋上全湿了。The garden needs to be watered twice a week in summer.
sceneCN: 这里 water 是「水」（第 1 个义项：雨水、河海中那种清澈的液体）；句意为夏天花园需要每周浇两次水。从指缝间淌下的水线就是这个词给的画面。

derivatives.zh: 加 -y 构成，义为「含水的；稀薄的」
加 -ing 构成，义为「浇水；灌溉」

senses.title: The liquid we drink
senses.definition: the clear liquid that has no colour, taste or smell, and that all life needs
senses.definitionCN: 无色无味、一切生命都需要的清澈液体
senses.example: He drank a glass of water and sat down.
senses.exampleCN: 他喝了一杯水，然后坐下。
senses.why: The basic sense is the liquid itself, the one thing the word has meant for over a thousand years.
senses.whyCN: 基本义就是这种液体本身，一千多年来这个词一直指它。

senses.title: A sea, lake or river area
senses.definition: in the plural or with a modifier, an area of sea, lake or river
senses.definitionCN: 用复数或加修饰语，指海、湖或河的一片区域
senses.example: The boat drifted into shallow waters near the shore.
senses.exampleCN: 小船漂进了近岸的浅水区。
senses.why: Where the liquid lies in a body large enough to name, the plural waters marks out that area.
senses.whyCN: 当这种液体聚成足够大、值得命名的一片时，用复数 waters 指那片区域。

senses.title: To pour water on plants
senses.definition: to pour water on plants or soil so that they can grow
senses.definitionCN: 给植物或土壤浇水以助其生长
senses.example: She waters the herbs every morning before work.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天上班前给香草浇水。
senses.why: Making the noun do the work of a verb is the simplest step: to water is to give water.
senses.whyCN: 让名词直接充当动词是最简单的一步：water 就是给水。

senses.title: Of the eyes, to fill with tears
senses.definition: of the eyes, to fill with tears, often because of wind or onions
senses.definitionCN: 眼睛因风或洋葱等而充满泪水
senses.example: The smoke made his eyes water.
senses.exampleCN: 烟熏得他眼睛流泪。
senses.why: The eye filling with liquid is water appearing where it does not belong, so the verb describes that too.
senses.whyCN: 眼里盈满液体，就是水出现在了不该出现的地方，于是动词也兼指此事。

senses.title: To give animals a drink
senses.definition: to lead animals to drink or to give them water
senses.definitionCN: 把牲畜牵去饮水或给它们水喝
senses.example: He watered the horses before the long ride.
senses.exampleCN: 长途骑行之前他先给马饮了水。
senses.why: Farm work made this a fixed use early: to water stock is to supply the one thing they must have.
senses.whyCN: 农活很早就固定了这一用法：water 牲畜就是供给它们必不可少的那个东西。

intro.en: Water is one of the oldest words in English, with the same root in German Wasser and Dutch water.
intro.cn: water 是英语最古老的词之一，德语 Wasser 与荷兰语 water 都出自同一词根。

items.en: The word was wæter, and it already meant both the liquid and a body of it.
items.cn: 古英语中作 wæter，当时就已兼指这种液体和一片水域。

items.en: The Germanic stem wat- spread across the family, giving German Wasser and Dutch water.
items.cn: 日耳曼词干 wat- 遍布整个语族，产生德语 Wasser 与荷兰语 water。

items.en: The root behind it probably meant wet or flow, linking the word to the way the liquid moves.
items.cn: 其词根大概意为「湿的、流动的」，把词与这种液体的流动方式联系起来。

items.en: The form water established itself and the verb to water appeared beside the noun.
items.cn: water 这一形式确立，动词 to water 也随名词出现。

items.en: The word then joined in dozens of compounds, from waterfall to waterproof, and in idioms for trouble.
items.cn: 此后这个词参与了大量复合词（从 waterfall 到 waterproof），也进入表示困境的习语。

note.en: The first group gathers compounds and forms of water, the second the words for the liquid in other states and for nearby things.
note.cn: 第一组收 water 的复合词与词形，第二组收液体的其他状态词与相关词。

entries.definition: Third person singular and the plural noun.
entries.definitionCN: 第三人称单数，也是名词复数

entries.definition: Past tense and past participle.
The adjective meaning full of water.
The -ing form and the noun for the job.
entries.definitionCN: 现在分词，也是表示浇水这一工作的名词

entries.definition: Anything that flows, water included.
Water made solid by cold.
Water turned to gas by heat.
Water falling from the clouds.

normalIntro.en: One old word for the liquid serves both as noun and as verb, and builds compounds by the dozen.
normalIntro.cn: 这个古老的液体名词既作名词也作动词，还能造出大量复合词。

normal.en: Water the plants: the noun is the verb.
normal.cn: water the plants：名词直接作动词。

normal.en: Waters means a stretch of sea or lake, not several liquids.
normal.cn: waters 指一片海或湖，而不是几种液体。

normal.en: In deep water means in trouble.
normal.cn: in deep water 意为陷入困境。

normal.en: Waterproof is water plus proof, able to keep it out.
normal.cn: waterproof 是 water 加 proof：能挡住水。

normal.en: Water becomes ice and steam: liquid, solid, gas.
normal.cn: 水可成冰也可成汽：液态、固态、气态。

abstract.en: Picture water slipping between your fingers.
abstract.cn: 想水从指缝间滑下。

abstract.en: Hear a hose spitting over flower beds.
abstract.cn: 听水管在花坛上洒水的声音。

abstract.en: Feel cold water up to the knees.
abstract.cn: 感受没到膝盖的冷水。

examples.en: The lake water was still and very cold.
examples.cn: 湖水静止，冰凉得很。

examples.en: Someone should water these flowers.
examples.cn: 得有人来浇一浇这些花。

examples.en: The company is in deep water over the deal.
examples.cn: 这家公司因这桩交易陷入困境。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「沃特」——沃特每天提着桶把菜地浇得湿漉漉的，桶沿还一路滴着水。

root: 古英语 wæter，来自日耳曼词干 wat-（湿的、流动），与德语 Wasser 同源。

sensesIntro.en: The liquid comes first, then a stretch of it, then the verb of pouring and drinking, and finally the tear in the eye.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是这种液体，接着是一片水域，然后是浇水与饮水的动作，最后是眼中的泪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: water running through open fingers.
core.cn: 核心意象：从张开的指缝间流过的水。

branches.en: The liquid branch: a glass after a meal.
branches.cn: 液体分支：饭后的一杯水。

branches.en: The waters branch: a boat in shallow waters.
branches.cn: 水域分支：浅水中的小船。

branches.en: The pouring branch: herbs watered at dawn.
branches.cn: 浇灌分支：清早浇过的香草。

branches.en: The eye branch: smoke that makes eyes water.
branches.cn: 眼睛分支：熏得流泪的烟。

branches.en: The stock branch: horses watered before the ride.
branches.cn: 牲畜分支：出发前饮过水的马。

intro.en: Water takes -y and -ing, -ed and -es, and serves as the first element of many compounds such as waterproof and underwater.
intro.cn: water 可加 -y、-ing、-ed、-es，并作为前项构成 waterproof、underwater 等大量复合词。

latinIntro.en: Water is one of the oldest Germanic words in English and has no Latin source, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: water 是英语中最古老的日耳曼词之一，没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁条目为空。

definition_zh: 防水的；不透水的；防水材料；使防水
definition_en: not letting water through, and to treat something so that water cannot pass
core_image: 雨衣上一颗水珠滚成一粒圆球，滑下去，衣面还是干的
scene: 山顶忽然下起雨，别人都在找地方躲，他把帽子一压，外套上全是滚落的水珠。Take a waterproof; the forecast is bad.
sceneCN: 这里 waterproof 是「防水的」（第 1 个义项：水透不过去）；句意为带件雨衣吧，预报说天气不好。雨衣上滚落的水珠就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 加 -ing 构成，义为「防水处理；防水材料」
过去分词作形容词，义为「做过防水处理的」
近义复合词，义为「抗水的」
近义复合词，义为「不透水的；严密的」

senses.title: Not letting water through
senses.definition: made or treated so that water cannot pass through
senses.definitionCN: 经过制作或处理，使水无法透过
senses.example: These boots are waterproof enough for crossing the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 这双靴子防水够好，可以蹚过小溪。
senses.why: Water plus proof, in the old sense of proof meaning «able to resist», gives exactly «no water gets through».
senses.whyCN: water 加上 proof（古义为「能抵御」），正好得出「水进不去」。

senses.title: A waterproof garment
senses.definition: a coat or other garment made of waterproof material, often called waterproofs in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 用防水材料制成的外套等，常用复数 waterproofs 指整套防水衣物
senses.example: Pack your waterproofs before you set off.
senses.exampleCN: 出发前把防水衣物装好。
senses.why: When the adjective is used so often with one kind of clothing, the adjective becomes the name of that clothing.
senses.whyCN: 当形容词常与某一类衣物连用时，形容词本身就变成了这类衣物的名字。

senses.title: To treat with a waterproof coating
senses.definition: to put a substance on something so that water cannot get in
senses.definitionCN: 在物体上涂敷物质，使水无法渗入
senses.example: They waterproofed the roof before the rainy season.
senses.exampleCN: 雨季之前他们给屋顶做了防水。
senses.why: Making an object waterproof is a job, so the adjective took a verb form: to waterproof something.
senses.whyCN: 让物体防水是一项工作，因此这个形容词也有了动词形式：to waterproof。

senses.title: Of things seen as roughly water-safe
senses.definition: in product labels, said of watches and phones that survive contact with water, though often not deep diving
senses.definitionCN: 在商品标识中形容手表、手机等不怕接触水，但通常并非深潜可用
senses.example: The watch is waterproof to fifty metres.
senses.exampleCN: 这只手表防水深度五十米。
senses.why: Labels need a short, strong word, so waterproof was stretched to cover everything from ink to watches, with a stated depth.
senses.whyCN: 标签需要一个简短有力的词，于是 waterproof 被扩展到从墨水到手表，再附上一个标注深度。

intro.en: Waterproof is an English compound of water and proof, where proof keeps its old sense of «able to resist».
intro.cn: waterproof 由 water 与 proof 合成的英语复合词，其中 proof 保留着「能抵御」的古义。

items.en: Proof comes from the Latin probare through Old French, and first meant the act of testing.
items.cn: proof 经古法语来自拉丁语 probare，最初指「检验」这一行为。

items.en: From testing, proof came to mean tried and found good, and then able to resist, as in fireproof.
items.cn: 由检验引申出「经过试验而可靠」，再引申为「能抵御」，如 fireproof。

items.en: Water and proof were joined in the eighteenth century to describe cloth that rain could not pass.
items.cn: 十八世纪 water 与 proof 合成一词，用来形容雨透不过的布料。

items.en: Vulcanised rubber and waxed cloth made waterproofing a trade, with its own craftsmen.
items.cn: 硫化橡胶与蜡布使防水处理成为一门有专门匠人的行业。

items.en: The word now labels watches, phones and mascara, always with an implied «how deep» or «how long».
items.cn: 如今这词标在手电、手机与睫毛膏上，总暗含「多深」或「多久」。

note.en: The first group gathers words built on waterproof and its near partners, the second the related -proof compounds and resistance words.
note.cn: 第一组收 waterproof 的派生与近邻词，第二组收同类 -proof 复合词与表示抵挡的词。

entries.definitionCN: 指防水处理本身的名词

entries.definition: Closed so tightly that no water can enter at all.
Resists water but is not fully proof against it.

entries.definitionCN: 雨衣，最常被称作 waterproof 的衣物

entries.definitionCN: 同样的 -proof 构法，只是防的是火

entries.definition: Not allowing liquid to pass, a formal word.

normalIntro.en: Water plus proof: proof here is not evidence but resistance, as in fireproof and soundproof.
normalIntro.cn: water 加 proof：这里的 proof 不是「证据」而是「抵御」，正如 fireproof、soundproof。

normal.en: Proof means proof against, not proof of.
normal.cn: 这里的 proof 是「防住」，不是「证明」。

normal.en: Waterproof is total; water-resistant only resists.
normal.cn: waterproof 是全防，water-resistant 只是抗。

normal.en: Waterproofs as a plural noun means the rain clothes you pack.
normal.cn: 复数名词 waterproofs 指打包带的雨具。

normal.en: The verb keeps the same spelling: to waterproof a roof.
normal.cn: 动词拼写不变：to waterproof a roof。

normal.en: Watertight is stronger still: nothing gets in at all.
normal.cn: watertight 更强：一点都进不去。

abstract.en: Picture round drops rolling off a sleeve.
abstract.cn: 想圆滚滚的水珠从衣袖上滚下。

abstract.en: Hear rain drumming and nothing reaching your skin.
abstract.cn: 听雨点敲打，却一丝没透到身上。

abstract.en: See a label: waterproof to fifty metres.
abstract.cn: 想标签上写着：防水五十米。

examples.en: You will need a waterproof coat for the hills.
examples.cn: 上山你需要一件防水外套。

examples.en: The tent is waterproof but the seams are not.
examples.cn: 帐篷是防水的，但接缝不是。

examples.en: They waterproofed the boots before the trip.
examples.cn: 出发前他们给靴子做了防水。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「沃特普鲁夫」——沃特普鲁夫站在雨里，衣服上的水珠一颗颗滚下去，里面却干得能摊开报纸。

root: water（水）+ proof（古义「能抵御」），为十八世纪英语复合词。

sensesIntro.en: The adjective comes first, then the garment it names, then the verb of treating something, and finally its use on product labels.
sensesIntro.cn: 先讲形容词，再讲它命名的衣物，然后是做处理的动词，最后是它在商品标签上的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drop beading up and rolling off a sleeve.
core.cn: 核心意象：在衣袖上聚成珠、滚下去的一滴水。

branches.en: The material branch: boots that cross a stream.
branches.cn: 材料分支：能蹚过小溪的靴子。

branches.en: The clothing branch: waterproofs packed for the trip.
branches.cn: 衣物分支：为出行打包的雨具。

branches.en: The treating branch: a roof sealed for the rains.
branches.cn: 处理分支：为雨季封好的屋顶。

branches.en: The label branch: a watch rated to fifty metres.
branches.cn: 标签分支：标称五十米的手表。

branches.en: The trade branch: waxed cloth and waterproofing craft.
branches.cn: 行业分支：蜡布与防水手艺。

intro.en: Waterproof joins two free words and then takes -s, -ed and -ing like any verb; -ial words such as impermeable are its formal relatives.
intro.cn: waterproof 由两个自由词合成，再像普通动词一样加 -s、-ed、-ing；impermeable 一类正式词是它的远亲。

latinIntro.en: The element proof entered English through Old French from Latin probare, to test, which is where its sense of resistance grew.
latinIntro.cn: 构件 proof 经古法语来自拉丁语 probare（检验），「抵御」之义正是在那里长出来的。

scene: 船开出港后，甲板上的人一直朝岸上挥手，直到彼此只剩一个小点。A huge wave broke over the rocks.
sceneCN: 这里 wave 是「挥手」（第 2 个义项：抬手来回摆动作招呼）；句意为一个巨浪打过礁石。海面上那条隆起的浪线就是这个词给人的画面。

pos.zh: 波浪；挥手；浪潮；（头发的）卷曲

collocations.phrase: the wave broke on the shore

现在分词作形容词，义为「飘扬的；挥动的」

senses.title: A line of water moving in
senses.definition: one of the ridges of water that move across the surface of the sea
senses.definitionCN: 海面上向前推进的一道道隆起的水脊
senses.example: A huge wave broke over the rocks.
senses.exampleCN: 一个巨浪打过礁石。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the moving ridge of water, whose rising and falling shape explains every other use.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是移动的水脊，它一起一伏的形状解释了其余所有用法。

senses.title: A movement of the hand
senses.definition: a movement of the hand from side to side, usually to greet or to say goodbye
senses.definitionCN: 手来回摆动的动作，通常用于招呼或告别
senses.example: She gave a quick wave from the window.
senses.exampleCN: 她在窗口很快地挥了下手。
senses.why: A hand moved to and fro draws the same shape as a wave of water, so the greeting took the sea word.
senses.whyCN: 手来回摆动画出的形状与海浪相同，于是招呼的动作借用了海的名字。

senses.title: To move the hand in greeting
senses.definition: to move the hand or an object to and fro, especially as a sign
senses.definitionCN: 使手或物体来回摆动，尤作示意
senses.example: He waved until the bus turned the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 他挥手直到公交车转过街角。
senses.why: The verb is the action behind the noun: what a wave in hand is doing is waving.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是名词背后的动作：手里那一下「浪」正在做的事就是挥。

senses.title: A rush of feeling or events
senses.definition: a sudden increase of an emotion, an activity or a group of things arriving together
senses.definitionCN: 情绪、活动或成群事物的突然涌现
senses.example: A wave of relief went through the crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 一阵宽慰掠过人群。
senses.why: A wave comes over you and then passes, which is exactly how a fit of feeling or a sudden arrival behaves.
senses.whyCN: 浪会扑上来又退下去，这与一阵情绪或一波涌来的事物正相像。

senses.title: Energy travelling through space
senses.definition: in physics, a disturbance that carries energy through a medium or through space
senses.definitionCN: 物理学中携带能量在介质或空间中传播的扰动
senses.example: Sound waves travel more slowly through water than through air.
senses.exampleCN: 声波在水中的传播比在空气中慢。
senses.why: Such a disturbance rises and falls in a regular pattern, so physics borrowed the sea word for it.
senses.whyCN: 这种扰动有规律地起伏，于是物理学借用了海的词。

senses.title: A curl in the hair
senses.definition: one of the curves or curls in a person’s hair
senses.definitionCN: 头发的一处弯曲或卷曲
senses.example: She has a natural wave in her hair.
senses.exampleCN: 她的头发天生带卷。
senses.why: A curl bends and rises like a small wave, and the same shape named it.
senses.whyCN: 一缕卷发弯起的样子就像小浪，同一形状给了它这个名字。

intro.en: Wave goes back to Old English wafian, to move the hand to and fro, and the sea sense grew from the same picture of rising and falling.
intro.cn: wave 可追溯到古英语 wafian（手来回摆动），海的意思也出自同一幅起伏的画面。

items.en: The verb wafian meant to move to and fro, and it described both hands and banners.
items.cn: 动词 wafian 意为来回摆动，手与旗帜都可用它描写。

items.en: A related noun wæg meant a moving body of water, a billow on the sea.
items.cn: 同源名词 wæg 指移动的水体，即海上的巨浪。

items.en: The same stock gives German Woge, a wave of the sea, and Dutch golf, a swell.
items.cn: 同源的词还给出德语 Woge（海浪）与荷兰语 golf（涌浪）。

items.en: The two lines of meaning met, and one short word, wave, covered hand and sea alike.
items.cn: 两条意义线索汇合，一个短词 wave 同时覆盖了手与海。

items.en: Physics and fashion then lent it to sound waves, light waves and the curl of hair.
items.cn: 此后物理学与时尚又把它借给了声波、光波与头发的卷。

note.cn: 第一组收 wave 的形式与形近词，第二组收关于海的词与挥手、摆动一类动词。

normalIntro.en: One shape, many things: a hand, the sea, a feeling, a sound and a curl all rise and fall like a wave.
normalIntro.cn: 一个形状，许多事物：手、海、情绪、声音与卷发都像浪一样起伏。

normal.en: Wave goodbye: the hand makes the shape of a wave.
normal.cn: wave goodbye：手划出浪的形状。

normal.en: A wave of anger passes like a wave of water.
normal.cn: a wave of anger 像海浪一样过去。

normal.en: Sound waves and light waves follow the same word.
normal.cn: 声波、光波用的是同一个词。

normal.en: Wavy hair means hair with waves in it.
normal.cn: wavy hair 指带波浪的头发。

normal.en: Waver is a different verb: it means to hesitate.
normal.cn: waver 是另一个动词，意为犹豫。

abstract.en: See a line of water rise and break white.
abstract.cn: 想一道水线隆起又碎成白沫。

abstract.en: Picture an arm raised at a departing train.
abstract.cn: 想一只手臂朝着离站的火车举起。

abstract.en: Feel relief spread over a crowd at once.
abstract.cn: 感受宽慰一下子铺过人群。

examples.en: The waves were too high to swim in.
examples.cn: 浪太高，不能下水游泳。

examples.en: She waved to us from the top of the stairs.
examples.cn: 她在楼梯顶上朝我们挥手。

examples.en: A wave of applause met the singer.
examples.cn: 一阵掌声迎向那位歌手。

sensesIntro.en: The sea ridge is the root picture; the hand, the feeling, the sound and the curl all copy its rising and falling.
sensesIntro.cn: 海上的浪脊是根本画面；手、情绪、声音与卷发都在模仿它的起伏。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ridge of water rising and breaking.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道隆起又碎裂的水脊。

branches.en: The sea branch: a wave breaking over rocks.
branches.cn: 海洋分支：打过礁石的浪。

branches.en: The greeting branch: a hand at a window.
branches.cn: 招呼分支：窗口挥动的手。

branches.en: The feeling branch: relief through a crowd.
branches.cn: 情绪分支：掠过人群的宽慰。

branches.en: The physics branch: sound crossing water.
branches.cn: 物理分支：穿过水的声波。

branches.en: The hair branch: a natural curl.
branches.cn: 头发分支：天生的卷曲。

intro.en: Wave takes -y for the adjective, -er for the waver that hesitates, and joins micro- to make microwave.
intro.cn: wave 加 -y 成形容词，加 -er 得表示犹豫的 waver，还与 micro- 组成 microwave。

latinIntro.en: Wave is native English from Old English wafian, with no Latin source, so the Latin list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: wave 是源自古英语 wafian 的本族词，没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁条目为空。
